title: thelypteris quadrangularis var. versicolor
intro: Thelypteris quadrangularis var. versicolor, commonly known as the variable fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The health benefits of Thelypteris quadrangularis var. versicolor include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
